acceptanceCriteria: The spec matrix row for SQL build-error matches the retained witnesses for both SQL profiles (verified against each receipt).
If refusal is implemented: a real runner witness and focused test show the refusal; otherwise the limitation is listed as a retained release blocker.
body: Found by independent Codex review of the batch PR beamfall/corvint#1000 (V1-0594 platform + V1-0593 Catch2, head 557b5757f) on 2026-10-17. docs/specs/test-runner-execution-v0.md ~L1363 (Platform qualification matrix 2026-10-17) says both SQL profiles refuse build-error, but the retained sqllogictest case /private/tmp/cem10-build/platform-2026-10-17/runs/sql-sqllogictest-sqlite/build-error/receipt.json executes `SELECT FROM WHERE` and records complete:true, one FAILED/UNKNOWN suite, no problems and no receipt error. Expected (TRE-V0-009): the matrix states only what the retained witness shows. Either correct the claim and retain the limitation as a blocker, or implement and qualify the refusal.
title: TRE platform qualification matrix claims SQL profiles refuse build-error; retained sqllogictest receipt shows complete FAILED/UNKNOWN
